name: tabs
summary: Navigates peer sections through bookmarkable links, without client-side tab panels.

agent.useWhen: Peer pages or server-owned filter states have stable URLs.
agent.avoidWhen: Content switches only in local browser state; use a tablist interaction then.

invariants: Contains 2 to 32 safe destinations, exactly one current; current uses aria-current=page.
The labelled navigation contains ordinary links and owns no panel, route, or client-side state.
Native JSON hrefs accept whole named routes calls; the host checks route existence, argument types, codecs and emission provenance.
